method.metric: Present cadence, not GPU render duration, server tick time or monitor displayed-frame cadence.
method.one_percent_low_definition: 1000 / arithmetic mean of the slowest ceil(interval_count * 0.01) native present intervals; not 1000/P99.
method.foreground_validation: Win32 foreground/minimization observation approximately every second; not continuous proof or modal-occlusion measurement.

etw.dropped_metric_note: Dropped presents remain in present-cadence intervals; mean FPS does not assert displayed FPS.
etw.mean_fps_definition: accepted_interval_count / sum(accepted MsBetweenPresents in seconds). With no invalid rows this equals (observed_present_rows - 1) / sum.

slowest_1_percent_fps.definition: 1000 divided by the arithmetic mean of the slowest ceil(accepted_interval_count * 0.01) present intervals; not the reciprocal of P99.

selection.note: Automatic selection is a recorded heuristic, not proof of the main game window. Every process/swapchain is reported independently; no groups are pooled.

visual_limits.note: Post-capture screenshots contain a rogue-reward popup; foreground telemetry does not measure modal occlusion.
